entries.final_answer: A: files on disk are the source of truth; show and set always read current files; the stored projection is only the change history; hand edits appear in show but emit no event; a later set records old as the value currently in the file.
options: Files on disk are truth; set diffs against current files; no reconcile events (recommended)
Projection is truth; show ignores hand edits
entries.question: When someone hand-edits the YAML files after the theatre was imported, should show/set treat the files on disk as the source of truth (event store records only commands' changes; no reconcile events), or should the stored projection win?
